_comment: Curated open-license organization/management theory corpus for APD. Each entry ingests as one `book` source. `access` is 'public' because every title here is public-domain or openly (CC) licensed and therefore redistributable; `license` records the exact terms (attribution is carried into the DB via `citation`). `fetch` describes how scripts/ingest-books.ts obtains the text: 'auto' = downloaded + converted by the script from `url`; 'manual' = multi-page source you download via the official export and convert with pdf_to_md.py into books/<id>.md before running the ingest.

books.title: The Principles of Scientific Management
books.author: Frederick Winslow Taylor
books.citation: Taylor, F. W. (1911). The Principles of Scientific Management. Harper & Brothers. Public domain.

books.title: Organizational Behavior

books.note: Download the official PDF from the OpenStax page, then: python pdf_to_md.py (or any heading-preserving converter) -> books/openstax-organizational-behavior.md
